title: 📖 CELPIP Reading: proof beats keyword matching
message:
🚀 *📖 CELPIP Reading: proof beats keyword matching*
✨ A common CELPIP reading problem is choosing the option that repeats a keyword, even when the meaning is wrong 👇
• Keyword match is only the start.
• Meaning match is the real check.
• 🎯 Exam move:
💡 Shared vocabulary is not enough without meaning match.

🔗 https://ieltscorner.ca/celpip/
#CELPIP #Reading #CLB8

interaction.question: What should decide your answer in CELPIP reading?
interaction.explanation: Shared vocabulary is not enough without meaning match.

title: ⚡ CELPIP Reading: matching words is not enough
message:
📌 *⚡ CELPIP Reading: matching words is not enough*
✨ One reading rule that saves marks 👇
• Do not choose an answer only because it repeats a word from the passage.
• Check whether it matches the idea exactly.
• 🎯 Mini challenge:
💡 Meaning and proof determine the correct answer.

🔗 https://ieltscorner.ca/celpip/
#CELPIP #Reading #CLB8

interaction.question: What is more important than keyword overlap?
interaction.explanation: Meaning and proof determine the correct answer.

title: 🎧 CELPIP Listening: hear the speaker attitude, not just the words
message:
🚀 *🎧 CELPIP Listening: hear the speaker attitude, not just the words*
✨ Some CELPIP listening answers depend more on attitude and intention than on direct facts 👇
• Listen for:
• tone changes
• stress on key words
💡 These questions often depend on tone, not just facts.

🔗 https://ieltscorner.ca/celpip/
#CELPIP #Listening #CLB9

interaction.question: What helps most with speaker attitude questions?
interaction.explanation: These questions often depend on tone, not just facts.

title: ⚡ CELPIP Listening: tone carries meaning too
message:
📌 *⚡ CELPIP Listening: tone carries meaning too*
✨ A fast listening reminder 👇
• Do not only hear the words.
• Hear the attitude behind them: annoyed, relieved, excited, unsure.
• 🎯 Mini challenge:
💡 They test whether you can interpret the speaker’s tone and purpose.

🔗 https://ieltscorner.ca/celpip/
#CELPIP #Listening #CLB9

interaction.question: What do attitude questions test?
interaction.explanation: They test whether you can interpret the speaker's tone and purpose.

title: 📧 CELPIP Task 1: match the tone to the situation
message:
🚀 *📧 CELPIP Task 1: match the tone to the situation*
✨ A surprising number of CELPIP Task 1 emails lose marks because the tone does not match the purpose 👇
• ❌ Hey, I want you to fix this problem now.
• ✅ I am writing to report an issue and request a prompt solution.
• 🎯 Exam move:
💡 Formal complaint emails need controlled, appropriate tone.

🔗 https://ieltscorner.ca/celpip/
#CELPIP #Writing #CLB9

interaction.question: Which line suits a formal complaint email better?
options: I am writing to express concern about the recent service issue.
interaction.explanation: Formal complaint emails need controlled, appropriate tone.

title: 📝 CELPIP Task 1: turn bullet points into paragraph jobs
message:
🚀 *📝 CELPIP Task 1: turn bullet points into paragraph jobs*
✨ Students know they must cover all Task 1 bullets, but many still miss one because they never convert the bullets into a writing plan 👇
• Better method:
• Bullet 1 = paragraph job 1
• Bullet 2 = paragraph job 2
💡 Turning bullets into clear jobs helps prevent missing content.

🔗 https://ieltscorner.ca/celpip/
#CELPIP #Writing #Task1

interaction.question: What is a safer planning method for Task 1?
options: Ignore the bullets after reading them
Convert each bullet into a job in your answer
interaction.explanation: Turning bullets into clear jobs helps prevent missing content.
